column1: # CyberDual window pins: the upstream default-branch commit every window is built from (p0_build_month.sh).
# Without a pin, a window built later can grow when upstream merges older-dated commits (2026-10-16 audit:
# expat 115 vs 124 commits). Pinned 2026-10-16T19:20:47Z to the then-current upstream tip. WINDOW_PIN=none disables.
